title: Deryck Whibley of Sum 41 Joins the Lineup for the 2027 iHeartRadio ALTer EGO Presented by Capital One on January 16 at the Kia Forum
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*Previously announced performers include Evanescence, The Offspring, a special performance from Billy Corgan, Death Cab for Cutie, Slightly Stoopid, Modest Mouse, Young the Giant, The Warning and Temper City*


*Tickets are on sale now via TicketMaster.com*


**WHAT:** iHeartMedia announced today that **Deryck Whibley of Sum 41** has been added to the lineup of the 2027 iHeartRadio ALTer EGO presented by Capital One, taking place on January 16 at the Kia Forum. Deryck Whibley of Sum 41 joined iHeartRadio ALT 98.7’s nationally syndicated “The Woody Show” this morning to share the news with listeners.


**WHO:** This year’s lineup for the 2027 iHeartRadio ALTer EGO presented by Capital One includes performances by **Deryck Whibley of Sum 41, Evanescence, The Offspring, a special performance from Billy Corgan, Death Cab for Cutie, Slightly Stoopid, Modest Mouse, Young the Giant, The Warning** and **Temper City.**


Deryck Whibley kicks off his new chapter of music with the announcement of[SUM 41 DIAMONDS OF THE NIGHT: VOL 1](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2F%2Fsum41.lnk.to%2FDOTNV1__%3B!!GeIQSb45FBw!tOAxypbk4f2uiZVKOW4n76QL-XPRCvz86tZ8g_taf6qC3d28MA5tm212Fj1ji9hNrmp87vgDws6Aj2KSvjpBXkQn6Q%24&data=05%7C02%7CPeytonWebb%40iheartmedia.com%7Ca2e06106f68842b338e408df44ee7e5c%7C122a527e5b714eba878d9810b495b9e3%7C0%7C0%7C639305463235052648%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=nkBeK5jxCN7UPI0XBAj1ULXppUwgsOIK2N0ghUFp8D4%3D&reserved=0) ** with Rise Records. Set to release on March 19, 2027, this is his first solo record offering listeners an intimate and reimagined look at Sum 41’s discography. The first single off his new record, “[With Me (First Dance Version)](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__http%3A%2Fsum41.lnk.to%2FWithMe__%3B!!GeIQSb45FBw!tyZKeZjgk6GJCrgwHCeibtIk4FfvGPC1yvVmw86_cebVoyTWLYL9dskTkeogvpsfdre9-1iHbsU%24&data=05%7C02%7CPeytonWebb%40iheartmedia.com%7Ca2e06106f68842b338e408df44ee7e5c%7C122a527e5b714eba878d9810b495b9e3%7C0%7C0%7C639305463235092756%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=uLtorTl68keFqUM6o%2BBGi18bGZ4EQ6MVh5mHfWnhq8Y%3D&reserved=0) ,” is available to stream now with a new music video fans can watch[HERE](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2F%2Fyoutu.be%2F20xvDlACSHY__%3B!!GeIQSb45FBw!tOAxypbk4f2uiZVKOW4n76QL-XPRCvz86tZ8g_taf6qC3d28MA5tm212Fj1ji9hNrmp87vgDws6Aj2KSvjpV_UGNnA%24&data=05%7C02%7CPeytonWebb%40iheartmedia.com%7Ca2e06106f68842b338e408df44ee7e5c%7C122a527e5b714eba878d9810b495b9e3%7C0%7C0%7C639305463235122785%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=MhHSqsmXEc1eYc6UY0miDnsMD4YAf%2BsOTOurlVk%2BXTI%3D&reserved=0) .


**WHEN:** Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 7:00 p.m. PT


**WHERE:** Kia Forum (3900 W Manchester Blvd, Inglewood, CA 90305)


**MORE:** Tickets on sale now via[TicketMaster.com.](https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/09006548A834A495)


iHeartRadio ALTer EGO presented by Capital One is part of iHeartMedia’s roster of incredibly successful, nationally recognized concert events, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival Presented by Capital One, iHeartRadio Music Awards, the nationwide iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour Presented by Capital One, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina, iHeartPodcast Awards and the iHeartCountry Festival presented by Capital One.


Proud partners of this year’s event include Presenting Partner Capital One, with more to be announced.
